## tryFiltered() function

Try to deserialize a FQN, but consider black-/whitelist

<b>Signature:</b>

```typescript
export declare function tryFiltered(fqn: FullyQualifiedName): Environmental | undefined;
```

## Parameters

|  Parameter | Type | Description |
|  --- | --- | --- |
|  fqn | [FullyQualifiedName](./environmentals.fullyqualifiedname.md) | String with the FullyQualifiedName |

<b>Returns:</b>

[Environmental](./environmentals.environmental.md) \| undefined

## Remarks

This function can be used to narrow down the resolved Parameters, for example for User Interfaces, where certain Parameters should not be displayed.

For this function to work you have to call [initialize()](./environmentals.initialize.md) first and provide either a whitelist or a blacklist or both. Parameters on the whitelist are always considered, even if also on the blacklist. If there is a whitelist provided, only the Parameters on that list will be returned. In the next step, Parameters from the blacklist are filtered out. If the Parameter is on neiher list, the function behaves just like [tryDeserialize()](./environmentals.trydeserialize.md)
